summary.text: Cody Reim represents Legislative District 3 in the Arizona House of Representatives, a district that includes North Scottsdale, Fountain Hills, Cave Creek, Carefree, New River and Anthem.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, he was appointed to the House in March 2026 by the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors.
The biography says he and his wife have lived in Arizona for fourteen years and have four children.
